First mechanical keyboard

During the covid lockdown, I got lucky and got one of the Bauer 2. I finally had some time to build it and I now can retire my loyal sticky razer friend. Now I know why people love mechanical keyboards :) It feels amazing to type. I used Tealio linear switches, after I completed the build I realized the W key was incredibly sensitive to any movement had to desolder and replace the switch. Now it is perfect. ​ https://preview.redd.it/rrk6be7xfi7a1.jpg?width=4032&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=55e8f08d193a518bd19050093170542b9284028b 11

Holy shit you started at the top!

I had to look it up. Very high end!

Gotta say this keyboard is pretty cool but it is probably overkill for me :) During covid lockdown there weren't many options to pick from and when I got lucky for the raffle I pulled the trigger. I also got treasure type-9 during the lockdown and I think that one looks even better. It is a 9-switch macro keyboard, that is going to be my next build.

Damn you went straight to boss lvl

Very nice build! Is that a Bauer? I’ve only seen the Bauer with a like WKL 65% layout, really wish more keyboards had this layout, the double blocker is an interesting look.

Yep, it is Bauer 2, I don't know the difference between the Bauer and Bauer 2 :) I really love this layout and it works really well with the game I am playing (HOTS). With my retired Razer keyboard, I found myself pressing the windows key a lot during gameplay, which was pretty annoying.
